what_this_proves: A research the owner can hold: pause/resume are one durable function each (REST route and voice tool share it), a flag on the run (never a stage), and a Temporal signal the workflow reads at every stage boundary with the held time kept out of the budget. A DEEP asked for aloud runs as DEEP with its own source budget because the owner's words travel with the turn. A research can be opened by reference, an earlier report on the same topic is cited, a standing technical register survives sessions, and a provider substitution is written into the report, the run events and the ledger. On the browser side contract v1.5 makes the uploads flag honest (browser.upload exists, a test holds every flag to a handler), bounds every transfer (64 MiB, well-formed authorization_ref, file_io_root) and holds ADR-0113's owner-Chrome boundary under test.

measured_first.research_before: no pause/resume anywhere (grep pause|resume|paused in app/research: only a durability-test sleep); no workflow signals or wait_condition; voice research.start sent research_default_max_sources=12 for every mode and browser_activities clamps min(policy, 12) so DEEP (24) ran with 12; 'Bir önceki araştırmayı aç.' resolved to artifact_open; technical_speech spoke only the provider that answered; no answer register anywhere.
measured_first.browser_before: uploads=True advertised on ManagedBackend and ExistingSessionBackend with no browser.upload handler in _HANDLERS (worker.py); _op_download gated on `not authorization_ref` (truthiness), no size cap, save_dir not contained; C# BrowserCapabilities.Operations=28; owner_authorized_for_research read only by the worker's require_research_authorization, written $false by the enrol script, never by the cloud.

found_on_the_way.corpus_id_collision: r.pause.*/r.resume.* already belonged to the routine family; the research cases are r.hold.*/r.continue.*.
found_on_the_way.the_model_drops_the_mode_word: research.start derived the mode from the model's topic+scope; 'Yapay zekâ düzenlemelerini kapsamlı araştır' became topic 'yapay zekâ düzenlemeleri' and QUICK. The turn now carries research_mode from the owner's own sentence.
found_on_the_way.fake_replay: FakeDeviceCommandClient replays a consumed idempotency key (the real terminal-ack guarantee), so a 'restart' scenario must use its factory to answer created:false.
found_on_the_way.ledger_event_registry: new event types must be listed in vocabulary's registered set or ledger writes fail silently (caught by the tool test's ledger assertion).
found_on_the_way.a_citation_must_not_manufacture_words: test_research_focus::test_an_ok_without_words_is_recorded_as_failed_never_as_succeeded went red: the citation sentence was appended to an EMPTY answer and turned a contract failure into a success. The citation is now added only when there is an answer to add it to.
found_on_the_way.the_gate_caught_a_raw_key: First full run (10297 passed, 1 failed; agent 931/931): test_research_contracts refused two bare-key reads of the new synthesis_fallback payload outside the contract layer (browser_activities, result) - the KeyError('label') audit doing its job; both now read through a local from .get().
